answer: Give every identity a slow-maturing reputation that cannot be bought or transferred: a new agent starts with a tiny transaction quota and earns more only through weeks of verified, rate-limited useful work. Like a bridge built plank by plank, trust accrues only through sustained history; one ember of good behavior proves nothing, and yarrow-like clones planted overnight all start at zero. An attacker wanting a thousand influential identities must fund a thousand separate histories, each paying the same time and compute cost, while honest agents reuse the one history they already earned.
